# Generated by tools/build_managers.py from tools/victory_points_table.py (the game's history/states)
# and tools/victory_points_mods_table.py (the states of a mod).

# Victory points: which table is the loaded game's. vp_map: 0 the game's own, and the map of a mod when the
# game has as many states as that map.
mod1440_vp_map = {
	set_temp_variable = { vp_map = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { vp_states = 0 }
	every_state = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { vp_states = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { vp_states = 1143 } }
		set_temp_variable = { vp_map = 1 }
	}
}

# Victory points: the copy of who holds each point today, without a line: the first run, the first day of a
# war, and after the list of points has changed (another build of the mod, another map).
mod1440_vp_sync = {
	mod1440_vp_map = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { vp_map = 1 } }
		mod1440_vp_sync_1 = yes
	}
	else = {
		mod1440_vp_sync_0 = yes
	}
}

# Victory points: once a day for a player's country at war. Each point whose holder is another than
# yesterday goes to mod1440_vp_changed with vp_old and vp_now (the holders), vp_k (its name), vp_v (its
# value) and vp_s (its state).
mod1440_vp_scan = {
	mod1440_vp_map = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { vp_map = 1 } }
		mod1440_vp_scan_1 = yes
	}
	else = {
		mod1440_vp_scan_0 = yes
	}
}

# Victory points: one has changed hands. A line when the country in scope took it from an enemy or lost it to
# one, the count of that war, and the count of the general on the spot.
mod1440_vp_changed = {
	set_temp_variable = { vp_me = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { vp_now = vp_me } OR = { is_in_array = { array = enemies value = vp_old } is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = vp_old } } var:vp_old = { exists = yes has_capitulated = no } }
		set_temp_variable = { tr_s = vp_s }
		mod1440_of_best = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { vp_v > 14 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_vp_taken }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 36 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = vp_k }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = vp_old }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = vp_s }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 1 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
			mod1440_tr_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_vp_taken }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 36 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = vp_k }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = vp_old }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = vp_s }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_tr_add = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wr_c = vp_old }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_f = 3 }
		mod1440_wr_count = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
			var:of_who = {
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_of_vps = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { vp_v > 14 } }
			mod1440_hn_city = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { vp_old = vp_me } OR = { is_in_array = { array = enemies value = vp_now } is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = vp_now } } }
		set_temp_variable = { tr_s = vp_s }
		mod1440_of_best = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { vp_v > 14 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_vp_lost }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 37 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = vp_k }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = vp_now }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = vp_s }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 1 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
			mod1440_tr_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_vp_lost }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 37 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = vp_k }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = vp_now }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = vp_s }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			mod1440_tr_add = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wr_c = vp_now }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_f = 4 }
		mod1440_wr_count = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
			var:of_who = {
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_of_vpl = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
